title: Lipschitz push-forward of integer multiplicity currents (Simon 3.9)
statement: For all P, Q, n, open U ⊆ ℝ^P and V ⊆ ℝ^Q, every integer multiplicity T ∈ D_n(U) and every f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q that is locally Lipschitz on U with f(U) ⊆ V and f⁻¹(K) ∩ spt T compact for every compact K ⊆ V, there is S ∈ D_n(V) such that S = f_#T in the sense of (3.6) (IsLipschitzPushforward T f S, i.e. S(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω(f(x)), L(x)_#ξ(x)⟩dHⁿ for a representation T = τ(M,θ,ξ) and linear maps L(x) giving the directional derivatives of f along the weighted approximate tangent space), and S is integer multiplicity.
